title: 为什么在群之后学习环？
Why study rings after groups?
text: 群描述一种可逆运算。整数的整除、矩阵的复合、多项式方程却同时需要加法与乘法；分配律把两种运算连接起来。环让我们把这些问题放在同一语言中研究。

Groups describe one invertible operation. Divisibility of integers, composition of matrices and polynomial equations require both addition and multiplication, linked by distributivity. Rings provide a common language.
example: 本章的三个问题：为什么模 6 不能随意约分？怎样把 x²+1 规定为 0？为什么同一个数会有不同的不可约分解？
Three questions: why does cancellation fail modulo 6; how can we impose x²+1=0; and why can a number have different irreducible factorizations?

title: 两种运算，三组公理
Two operations, three axioms
text: 环是带两个封闭运算的非空集合：加法成交换群，乘法满足结合律，且左右分配律成立。教材不要求乘法交换，也不要求存在乘法单位元。

A ring is a nonempty set with two closed operations: addition is an abelian group, multiplication is associative, and both distributive laws hold. Neither commutative multiplication nor a multiplicative identity is assumed.
warning: 0 是加法单位元；“加法交换”是公理，“乘法交换”是额外性质。提到有单位元的环时，本课程沿用教材约定 1≠0，另行讨论零环。
Zero is the additive identity. Addition must commute; multiplication need not. Following the textbook, a ring described as unital is assumed nonzero unless the zero ring is explicitly discussed.

title: 单位元与可逆元
Identity and units
text: 在有单位元的环中，可逆元（单位）要求左右逆相同。全部可逆元在乘法下组成单位群 U(R)。单位元是一个指定的元素，可逆元是一类元素。
In a unital ring a unit has a two-sided inverse. All units form a group U(R) under multiplication. The identity is one element; the units are a collection of elements.
proof: 若 e、f 都是单位元，则 e=ef=f。若 b、c 都是 a 的双侧逆，则 b=b(ac)=(ba)c=c。
If e,f are identities, e=ef=f. If b,c are two-sided inverses of a, then b=b(ac)=(ba)c=c.
1 可逆；若 a、b 可逆，则 (ab)⁻¹=b⁻¹a⁻¹；a 的逆本身也可逆。结合律从环继承，故 U(R) 是群。
The identity is a unit, (ab)⁻¹=b⁻¹a⁻¹, and an inverse is itself a unit. Associativity is inherited, so U(R) is a group.
example: U(ℤ)={±1}; U(Mₙ(F))=GLₙ(F); [a] is a unit of ℤₙ exactly when gcd(a,n)=1.

title: 交换性与单位元是独立条件
Commutativity and identity are separate
text: 偶数环交换但无单位元；矩阵环有单位元但不交换；有限个环的直和按分量相加、相乘。直和交换当且仅当各分量交换，有单位元当且仅当各分量有单位元。

The even integers form a commutative ring without identity. Matrix rings have an identity but need not commute. A finite direct sum uses componentwise operations and is commutative or unital exactly when every component is.
proof: 若 2ℤ 有单位元 e，由 2e=2 在整数中得 e=1，但 1∉2ℤ。
An identity e in 2ℤ would satisfy 2e=2, forcing e=1∉2ℤ.
矩阵单位 E₁₂E₂₁=E₁₁，而 E₂₁E₁₂=E₂₂，故 M₂(ℝ) 非交换。
Matrix units satisfy E₁₂E₂₁=E₁₁ but E₂₁E₁₂=E₂₂.
直和的公理逐分量验证；乘法单位元必须且只能由各分量单位元组成。
Verify the direct-sum axioms componentwise; its identity must consist of the component identities.

title: 零与负号的规则不是新公理
Zero and sign rules are consequences
text: 任意环中都有零的吸收律、负元的运算规则与 −(−a)=a。这些结论由加法群和分配律推出，不需要乘法单位元或交换性。
Every ring satisfies the zero-product and sign rules, including −(−a)=a. They follow from the additive group and distributivity, without a multiplicative identity or commutativity.
proof: a0=a(0+0)=a0+a0，在加法群中消去 a0 得 a0=0；0a 同理。
From a0=a(0+0)=a0+a0, additive cancellation gives a0=0. Similarly 0a=0.
a(−b)+ab=a(−b+b)=0，所以 a(−b) 是 ab 的加法逆元。对左侧负号同理。
Since a(−b)+ab=0, a(−b) is the additive inverse of ab; the left-hand sign is similar.
a 是 −a 的负元，故 −(−a)=a。于是 (−a)(−b)=−(a(−b))=ab。
Uniqueness of additive inverses gives −(−a)=a, and hence (−a)(−b)=ab.
warning: 这些消去都在加法群中进行；乘法消去律在一般环中会失败。
All cancellation here is additive. Multiplicative cancellation can fail in a ring.

title: 子环：只需检查差与积
Subrings: check differences and products
entries.tex: \varnothing\ne S\subseteq R:\quad S\le R\iff a-b,\ ab\in S\ (a,b\in S)
text: 子环使用 R 的原运算。非空子集 S 为子环，当且仅当它是加法子群且对乘法封闭；等价地，只需对差与积封闭。不额外要求包含 R 的单位元。

A subring uses the inherited operations. A nonempty subset is a subring exactly when it is an additive subgroup closed under products, equivalently closed under differences and products. It need not contain the identity of R.
proof: 必要性：子环是加法群，故对差封闭；乘法也必须封闭。
Necessity follows from the additive group and multiplicative closure.
充分性：取 s∈S，由 s−s=0 得 0∈S；由 0−a 得 −a∈S；再由 a−(−b) 得 a+b∈S。
Choose s∈S. Then 0=s−s∈S, −a=0−a∈S, and a+b=a−(−b)∈S.
加法交换律、乘法结合律与分配律直接从 R 继承，所以 S 是环。
Additive commutativity, multiplicative associativity and distributivity are inherited.
example: 2ℤ⊂ℤ 是子环；ℤ×{0}⊂ℤ×ℤ 是子环，其自身单位元 (1,0) 与大环单位元 (1,1) 不同。
2ℤ is a subring of ℤ. The subring ℤ×{0} of ℤ×ℤ has its own identity (1,0), different from (1,1).

title: 整数环与剩余类环的子环
Subrings of the integers and residue rings
text: ℤ 的所有子环恰为 dℤ（d≥0）；ℤₙ 的所有子环恰为 dℤₙ，其中 d 遍历 n 的正因子，d=n 表示零子环。这里也包含零子环，避免最小正元论证漏掉它。
The subrings of ℤ are dℤ for d≥0. Those of ℤₙ are dℤₙ for positive divisors d of n, with d=n giving the zero subring. The zero case must be handled before taking a least positive element.
proof: 非零子环 S 的加法群是 ℤ 的非零子群，故 S=dℤ；也可取最小正整数 d∈S，用带余除法证明所有元素都是 d 的倍数。
A nonzero subring is a nonzero additive subgroup of ℤ, hence dℤ; alternatively divide by its least positive element.
每个 dℤ 对差和积封闭。ℤₙ 的加法子群已经分类为 dℤₙ，而这些集合也对乘法封闭。
Each dℤ is closed under differences and products. The additive subgroups dℤₙ are likewise closed under multiplication.

title: 中心：取出所有可交换的元素
The center of a ring
text: 环的中心是与每个元素都交换的元素所成的集合。它是交换子环；若 R 有单位元，则中心包含该单位元。
The center consists of elements commuting with every element of R. It is a commutative subring, and contains the identity when R is unital.
proof: 0∈C(R)。若 a,b∈C(R)，则 (a−b)r=r(a−b)。
Zero lies in the center, and (a−b)r=r(a−b) for central a,b.
(ab)r=a(br)=a(rb)=(ar)b=(ra)b=r(ab)，所以对乘法封闭。
Associativity and centrality give (ab)r=a(br)=a(rb)=(ar)b=(ra)b=r(ab).
中心中的任意两个元素彼此交换；1 若存在则与所有元素交换。
Any two central elements commute; the identity, when present, is central.
example: 在 M₂(F) 中，与 E₁₁ 交换迫使非对角项为 0，再与 E₁₂ 交换迫使两个对角项相等，因此中心为 {aI:a∈F}。
In M₂(F), commuting with E₁₁ kills off-diagonal entries; commuting with E₁₂ makes the diagonal entries equal. Thus the center is {aI:a∈F}.

question: 按本教材，哪一条不是环的必需公理？
Which is not required for a ring in this textbook?
reason: 教材允许无单位元的环，例如 2ℤ。
Rings without identity, such as 2ℤ, are allowed.

question: ℤ₁₂ 中哪些元素恰好组成单位群？
Which list is exactly U(ℤ₁₂)?
reason: A class is invertible exactly when it is coprime to 12.

question: 对非空 S⊆R，哪组条件足以判定子环？
For nonempty S⊆R, which conditions characterize a subring?
reason: 差封闭给加法子群，乘法封闭再加继承的环公理即可。
Difference closure gives an additive subgroup; the remaining identities are inherited.

question: 在 M₂(ℝ) 中令 A=E₁₂、B=E₂₁，AB 等于什么？
For A=E₁₂ and B=E₂₁ in M₂(ℝ), what is AB?
reason: 矩阵单位满足 EᵢⱼEₖℓ=δⱼₖEᵢℓ，所以 AB=E₁₁，而 BA=E₂₂。
Matrix units give E₁₂E₂₁=E₁₁, while the reverse product is E₂₂.

question: 证明任意环中 a(−b)=−ab，并说明是否用到单位元。
Prove a(−b)=−ab in any ring, and identify whether an identity is used.
reason: 先由 a0=a0+a0 得 a0=0。再由 a(−b)+ab=a(−b+b)=0，负元唯一性给出结论。不需要乘法单位元或交换性。
Additive cancellation in a0=a0+a0 gives a0=0. Then a(−b)+ab=0, so uniqueness of the additive inverse gives the claim. Neither identity nor multiplicative commutativity is used.
